brightLineRuling.reason: always_allow can enable two immediate territorial captures, but the bounded proposal retains a freely chosen three-option decision, historical/counterfactual truth, full costs, canonical receipts, and civilian/war-crime accounting without target selection, KPI linkage, or recommendation.

complete effective control of every irregular group at turn 0

bindings.requirement: Queue exactly one policy decision after the explicit turn-0 RBiH identity receipt and before Advance; retain ask until response; keep deny, ask, and allow equally operable and unselected; add no pressure, countdown, recommendation, or focus-as-consent behavior.

Forbid selection or inference from Historical mode, identity, harness flags, retries, save/load, hydration, IPC redelivery, fallback, or headless behavior; require one visible player action, one player-source receipt, fail-closed errors, and no duplicates.

Preserve every authored option and all labels, descriptions, markers, sources, assessments, future consequences, previews, flags, dimensions, modifiers, notifications, and causality, including allow's civilian/war-crime disclosure and complete political and recruitment costs.

Move the whole event and exact clocks to turn 0; prohibit direct writes, provisional overrides, second authorities, reduced costs, later duplicate events, and split receipts; any consequence that cannot move intact voids the verdict.

Route every enabled deployment and capture through all existing detection, spawn, advance, displacement/civilian-casualty, war_crimes_events, standing, condemnation, ledger, and provenance writers; any missing, delayed, reset, suppressed, or selective accounting blocks.

Add no parity, recovery, optimal-play, stronger-opening, territorial-opportunity, military-necessity, score, grade, achievement, recommendation, casualty-to-territory, territory-per-atrocity, or mitigation frame; human cost remains neutral-or-worse in every score dimension.

Keep always_deny the historical default and ask/always_allow counterfactual; describe the event as a general command abstraction, not a dated incident or achieved control; use the approved April sources and never the two captures as historical evidence.

Limit proof to two immediate differences and pre-first-Advance capability; make no claim about all seven January differences, score 707, turn-39/188 equivalence, historical parity, calibration fitness, or acceptance-floor satisfaction.

Preserve n91-n95 and all telemetry byte-identically; change no event data, headless/no-player behavior, sweep/target/control/capture/scoring logic, policy values, historical default, protected controls, baselines, thresholds, or acceptance criteria.

Use focused RED/GREEN proof for explicit branches, clocks, hostile cases, receipt idempotence, persistence, Electron/browser equivalence, and civilian/war-crime accounting; never relabel the frozen b371adc3e suite as implementation evidence or run a package/campaign for reassurance.

Stop and surface the owner on coercive, efficient, historically normal, calibration-required, territory-offsetting, or incompletely accounted behavior, or whenever free refusal is in doubt; do not reinterpret the gate to save the candidate.
